# infoblox_ipv6_dhcp_optionspace (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Infoblox Ipv6DhcpOptionspace from both the NIOS and UDDI backends.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve a specific IPv6 DHCP Option Space by filters
data "infoblox_ipv6_dhcp_optionspace" "get_ipv6_dhcp_option_space_using_filters" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_option_space_1"
  }
}

// Retrieve all IPv6 DHCP Option Spaces
data "infoblox_ipv6_dhcp_optionspace" "get_all_ipv6_dhcp_option_spaces" {}
```

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve a specific IPv6 DHCP Option Space by filters
data "infoblox_ipv6_dhcp_optionspace" "get_ipv6_option_space_by_name" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_option_space_1"
  }
}

// Retrieve a specific IPv6 DHCP Option Space by tags
data "infoblox_ipv6_dhcp_optionspace" "get_option_space_by_tag" {
  tag_filters = {
    Site = "location-1"
  }
}

// Retrieve all IPv6 DHCP Option Spaces
data "infoblox_ipv6_dhcp_optionspace" "get_all_option_spaces" {}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes.
- `limit` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for UDDI backend.
- `max_results` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for NIOS backend.
- `paging` (Number) Enable (1) or disable (0) paging for the data source query. Enabled by default. When disabled, only a single page of results is retrieved.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. Only applicable for UDDI backend.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The reference to the object.
- `nios` (Attributes) NIOS backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios))
- `uddi` (Attributes) UDDI backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--uddi))

<a id="nestedatt--results--nios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.nios`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) A descriptive comment of a DHCP IPv6 option space object.
- `enterprise_number` (Number) The enterprise number of a DHCP IPv6 option space object.
- `name` (String) The name of a DHCP IPv6 option space object.


<a id="nestedatt--results--uddi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.uddi`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) The description for the option space. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `name` (String) The name of the option space. Must contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `protocol` (String) The type of protocol for the option space (_ip4_ or _ip6_).
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the option space in JSON format.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All tags including inherited values.
